stage1.impression: A warm, well-composed run down a fluted-timber counter toward the shopfront, and the plan of it is promising, but it reads as a graded CG render, not a night photograph: the blacks are lifted and milky under a sepia film-grain grade, the counter top and near seat cushions are near-white and flat, the record wall is lit evenly like a library, and big soft blob shadows lie on the floor like puddles. There is no colour hero: the only saturated mark is a small striped column on the counter, the speaker behind the decks is a washed grey disc, and the pendants read as generic white enamel domes. As it stands a magazine would see a generic, catalogue-like bar, not a specific place.

blocking_9: A clear colour hero in frame: the card calls Mother EARF the room's centrepiece, but it sits outside this frame, and the smoked Tropos in the back bar reads as a grey disc (region 790-870 x 280-420, lum_median 128, r/g/b 141/126/112, no tint)

True blacks with detail: the grade lifts every shadow to a milky brown (frame lum_p5 13, but the shadows look veiled and the tone is flat); deep shadows should read as near black with texture, not haze
The counter top and near cushions must read as zinc and leather, not paper-white planes (counter top 460-1200 x 430-560 median 152; near cushion 640-860 x 735-800 median 218)
The Dome pendants must read as smoked tinted acrylic with a glowing liner and a polished rim, not as opaque white enamel shades
The record wall needs pools and fall-off (spots grazing the spines), not flat even fill (910-1200 x 0-440, median 80, p95 220, uniformly bright)
No floor-shadow artefacts: the large soft dark blobs on the concrete (0-450 x 560-750) read as stains or render artefacts

defects.what: Large soft dark blob shadows on the floor, shapes not attributable to any object; they read as stains or puddles
Zinc counter top reads as pale flat concrete or paper, median 152, no zinc patina, sheen or reflection of the pendants
Near stool cushion close to white (median 218), no leather grain; it reads as a plastic disc
Dome pendant reads as opaque white enamel; liner flat white, clip 0.31 %; the smoked acrylic tint does not read
Second Dome likewise flat white, no polished glowing rim, no tint
Tropos speaker in the back bar is low-contrast grey behind a glass reflection; not the hero, the tint does not read
Record wall lit flat and evenly; the sleeves read as pale book spines, no pools of light or highlights
Back-lit screen with the dancer silhouette reads as a poster or lightbox; it is the brightest flat plane at the end of the room and pulls the eye
Global sepia grade with lifted blacks and coarse grain or denoiser texture; reads as a filter, not a lens
The only saturated colour in frame is a small striped column (the EARFcoin request column), median 201: it competes with the speaker as the colour mark
Banquette and shopfront side very dark and featureless (median 20.5); the street at night barely reads

changes.problem: The frame has no colour hero: Mother EARF, the card's centrepiece, is out of frame and the smoked Tropos reads as a grey disc.

evidence.measured: speaker lum_median 128.5, r/g/b 141/126/112 (no tint); no region of saturated EARF colour anywhere except the small coin column

change.to: pan right to about [4.6, 2.9, 1.6] and widen to 28 mm, so that Mother EARF (at y 1.15, z 2.47) enters the right or upper third with the counter still running in from the left

changes.expected: The six tinted rims and their coloured shadow on the concrete become the frame's one saturated mark, read at a glance, with the counter as the leading line

changes.problem: The grade lifts the blacks into a milky sepia veil and sits the frame above the target brightness, so it reads as a filtered render.

evidence.measured: frame lum_median 53.9 (target 22-50), p5 13.2; ceiling 0-700 x 0-220 r/g/b 68/34/17 (heavy orange cast)

change.from: exposure 4.0, AgX Medium High Contrast, 3000 K
change.to: exposure 3.4, AgX High Contrast (or Medium High with no lift in post), white_balance_k 2800 so that the 2400 K practicals stay warm but the concrete reads grey-warm rather than orange; remove any film-grain or haze overlay in post

changes.expected: Frame median about 38-45, deep shadows near black with texture, practicals still bright

changes.problem: The zinc counter top reads as flat pale paper rather than patinated zinc.

evidence.measured: lum_median 152, p95 239.5, clip 0.09 %; no specular pools under the pendants

change.to: darker blue-grey patinated zinc (base around #5E6266), roughness about 0.35 with wear variation, so that each Dome downlight leaves a soft specular pool and the rest falls toward grey

changes.expected: The counter reads as metal, with pools under the four Domes and darker runs between them

changes.problem: The Dome pendants read as opaque white enamel; the smoked acrylic and its glowing liner don't read.

evidence.measured: lum_median 185, clip 0.31 %, near neutral r/g/b 204/182/168; same at [1060, 170, 1180, 235], median 192

change.setting: each Dome liner glow / Dome wattage
change.to: liner glow 0.02, Dome 18 W, so that the smoked outer shell reads darker than the liner and the polished rim catches light

changes.expected: Shades read as smoked translucent domes with a soft inner glow and a bright rim line, no clipping

changes.problem: The record wall is lit flat and evenly, like a library, with no pools of light and fall-off.

evidence.measured: lum_median 80, p95 220; vertical fall-off minimal across the shelves

change.setting: record wall spots (4 x spot) and the Domes' downlights
change.to: 4.0 W, cone 16 deg, aimed to graze the spines in four separate pools; reduce the fill bouncing off the counter (it is the zinc change in c3)

changes.expected: Distinct pools on the record wall with dark gaps between, sleeves catching small highlights

changes.problem: Large soft blob shadows on the floor have no apparent source and read as stains.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: three or four elongated dark ellipses crossing the walkway, unrelated to the stools' legs, which cast thin crisp shadows nearby

change.setting: the source of the blob shadows (likely the street lamps' point lights or the Domes' downlights passing through a hidden object); plus the floor's polish
change.from: street lamps 8.0 W points; floor polish as now
change.to: find the occluding object and hide it, or turn the street lamps into small area lamps (0.3 m) outside the glass; raise the floor's polish slightly so that it picks up soft reflections of the pendants

changes.expected: Floor shows only the stools' crisp leg shadows and soft reflections; no blobs

changes.problem: The near stool cushions are near-white and read as plastic discs at the frame's closest point.

change.setting: cushion leather finish (a material finish; the seat design is unchanged)
change.to: if the seat's colour is fixed, keep it but add leather grain and roughness 0.5 and lower the Dome downlight spill on it (c4); otherwise darken the base value about 30 %

changes.expected: The cushions read as leather with grain, no longer the brightest object in the foreground

changes.problem: The back-lit dancer screen at the end of the room is the brightest flat plane on the axis and pulls the eye like a lightbox.

evidence.measured: lum_median 109, very even (lum_range 97 over a flat panel)

changes.expected: The screen sits back as a soft glow, the counter and its pendants lead

out_of_scope.request: Give the Tropos in the back-bar niche a stronger tint so that it reads as the hero
out_of_scope.why: Its colour is fixed by the Smoke configuration; the hero colour must come from Mother EARF via the camera (c1) or from the light through the speaker's acrylic

out_of_scope.request: Replace the generic-looking white seat cushions with a darker upholstery
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed in the room's design; only their finish and light can change (c7)

out_of_scope.request: Make the record wall's shelving less uniform (varied sleeves, gaps, a record leaning out)
out_of_scope.why: The record wall is fixed; small props such as a record out of its sleeve may be added, but its structure may not
